verses.en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Israel tornaram a fazer o que era mau aos olhos do Senhor, e ele os entregou na mão dos filisteus por quarenta anos.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight; and Yahweh delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Israel again did evil in the eyes of the Lord; and the Lord gave them into the hands of the Philistines for forty years.

verses.en: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and bare not.
verses.pt: Havia um homem de Zorá, da tribo de Dã, cujo nome era Manoá; e sua mulher, sendo estéril, não lhe dera filhos.
verses.en_web: There was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and childless.
verses.en_bbe: Now there was a certain man of Zorah of the family of the Danites, and his name was Manoah; and his wife had never given birth to a child.

verses.en: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto the woman, and said unto her, Behold now, thou art barren, and bearest not: but thou shalt conceive, and bear a son.
verses.pt: Mas o anjo do Senhor apareceu à mulher e lhe disse: Eis que és estéril, e nunca deste à luz; porém conceberás, e terás um filho.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s angel appeared to the woman, and said to her, “See now, you are barren and childless; but you shall conceive, and bear a son.
verses.en_bbe: And the angel of the Lord came to the woman, and said to her, See now! though you have never given birth to children, you will be with child and give birth to a son.

verses.en: Now therefore beware, I pray thee, and drink not wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean thing:
verses.pt: Agora pois, toma cuidado, e não bebas vinho nem bebida forte, e não comas coisa alguma impura;
verses.en_web: Now therefore please beware and drink no wine nor strong drink, and don’t eat any unclean thing:
verses.en_bbe: Now then take care to have no wine or strong drink and to take no unclean thing for food;

verses.en: For, lo, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and no razor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.pt: porque tu conceberás e terás um filho, sobre cuja cabeça não passará navalha, porquanto o menino será nazireu de Deus desde o ventre de sua mãe; e ele começara a livrar a Israel da mão dos filisteus.
verses.en_web: for, behold, you shall conceive, and give birth to a son. No razor shall come on his head; for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb. He shall begin to save Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.”
verses.en_bbe: For you are with child and will give birth to a son; his hair is never to be cut, for the child is to be separate to God from his birth; and he will take up the work of freeing Israel from the hands of the Philistines.

verses.en: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of God came unto me, and his countenance was like the countenance of an angel of God, very terrible: but I asked him not whence he was, neither told he me his name:
verses.pt: Então a mulher entrou, e falou a seu marido, dizendo: Veio a mim um homem de Deus, cujo semblante era como o de um anjo de Deus, em extremo terrível; e não lhe perguntei de onde era, nem ele me disse o seu nome;
verses.en_web: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, “A man of God came to me, and his face was like the face of the angel of God, very awesome. I didn’t ask him where he was from, neither did he tell me his name;
verses.en_bbe: Then the woman came in, and said to her husband, A man came to me, and his form was like the form of a god, causing great fear; I put no question to him about where he came from, and he did not give me his name;

verses.en: But he said unto me, Behold, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean thing: for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death.
verses.pt: porém disse-me: Eis que tu conceberás e terás um filho. Agora pois, não bebas vinho nem bebida forte, e não comas coisa impura; porque o menino sera nazireu de Deus, desde o ventre de sua mãe até o dia da sua morte.
verses.en_web: but he said to me, ‘Behold, you shall conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink. Don’t eat any unclean thing; for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb to the day of his death.’”
verses.en_bbe: But he said to me, You are with child and will give birth to a son; and now do not take any wine or strong drink or let anything unclean be your food; for the child will be separate to God from his birth to the day of his death.

verses.en: Then Manoah intreated the LORD, and said, O my Lord, let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.
verses.pt: Então Manoá suplicou ao Senhor, dizendo: Ah! Senhor meu, rogo-te que o homem de Deus, que enviaste, venha ter conosco outra vez e nos ensine o que devemos fazer ao menino que há de nascer.
verses.en_web: Then Manoah entreated Yahweh, and said, “Oh, Lord, please let the man of God whom you sent come again to us, and teach us what we should do to the child who shall be born.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Manoah made prayer to the Lord, and said, O Lord, let the man of God whom you sent come to us again and make clear to us what we are to do for the child who is to come.

verses.en: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field: but Manoah her husband was not with her.
verses.pt: Deus ouviu a voz de Manoá; e o anjo de Deus veio outra vez ter com a mulher, estando ela sentada no campo, porém não estava com ela seu marido, Manoá.
verses.en_web: God listened to the voice of Manoah, and the angel of God came again to the woman as she sat in the field, but Manoah, her husband, wasn’t with her.
verses.en_bbe: And God gave ear to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came to the woman again when she was seated in the field; but her husband Manoah was not with her.

verses.en: And the woman made haste, and ran, and shewed her husband, and said unto him, Behold, the man hath appeared unto me, that came unto me the other day.
verses.pt: Apressou-se, pois, a mulher e correu para dar a notícia a seu marido, e disse-lhe: Eis que me apareceu aquele homem que veio ter comigo o outro dia.
verses.en_web: The woman hurried and ran, and told her husband, and said to him, “Behold, the man who came to me that day has appeared to me,”
verses.en_bbe: So the woman, running quickly, gave her husband the news, saying, I have seen the man who came to me the other day.

verses.en: And Manoah arose, and went after his wife, and came to the man, and said unto him, Art thou the man that spakest unto the woman? And he said, I am.
verses.pt: Então Manoá se levantou, seguiu a sua mulher e, chegando à presença do homem, perguntou-lhe: És tu o homem que falou a esta mulher? Ele respondeu: Sou eu.
verses.en_web: Manoah arose, and followed his wife, and came to the man, and said to him, “Are you the man who spoke to my wife?” He said, “I am.”
verses.en_bbe: And Manoah got up and went after his wife, and came up to the man and said to him, Are you the man who was talking to this woman? And he said, I am.

verses.en: And Manoah said, Now let thy words come to pass. How shall we order the child, and how shall we do unto him?
verses.pt: Então disse Manoá: Quando se cumprirem as tuas palavras, como se há de criar o menino e que fará ele?
verses.en_web: Manoah said, “Now let your words happen. What shall the child’s way of life and mission be?”
verses.en_bbe: And Manoah said, Now when your words come true, what is to be the rule for the child and what will be his work?

verses.en: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware.
verses.pt: Respondeu o anjo do Senhor a Manoá: De tudo quanto eu disse à mulher se guardará ela;
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s angel said to Manoah, “Of all that I said to the woman let her beware.
verses.en_bbe: And the angel of the Lord said to Manoah, Let the woman take note of what I have said to her.

verses.en: She may not eat of any thing that cometh of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: all that I commanded her let her observe.
verses.pt: de nenhum produto da vinha comerá; não beberá vinho nem bebida forte, nem comerá coisa impura; tudo quanto lhe ordenei cumprirá.
verses.en_web: She may not eat of anything that comes of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing. Let her observe all that I commanded her.”
verses.en_bbe: She is to have nothing which comes from the vine for her food, and let her take no wine or strong drink or anything which is unclean; let her take care to do all I have given her orders to do.

verses.en: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, I pray thee, let us detain thee, until we shall have made ready a kid for thee.
verses.pt: Então Manoá disse ao anjo do Senhor: Deixa que te detenhamos, para que te preparemos um cabrito.
verses.en_web: Manoah said to Yahweh’s angel, “Please stay with us, that we may make a young goat ready for you.”
verses.en_bbe: And Manoah said to the angel of the Lord, Now let us keep you while we make ready a young goat for you.

verses.en: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Though thou detain me, I will not eat of thy bread: and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering, thou must offer it unto the LORD. For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of the LORD.
verses.pt: Disse, porém, o anjo do Senhor a Manoá: Ainda que me detenhas, não comerei de teu pão; e se fizeres holocausto, é ao Senhor que o oferecerás. (Pois Manoá não sabia que era o anjo do Senhor).
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s angel said to Manoah, “Though you detain me, I won’t eat your bread. If you will prepare a burnt offering, you must offer it to Yahweh.” For Manoah didn’t know that he was Yahweh’s angel.
verses.en_bbe: And the angel of the Lord said to Manoah, Though you keep me I will not take of your food; but if you will make a burned offering, let it be offered to the Lord. For it had not come into Manoah's mind that he was the angel of the Lord.

verses.en: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, What is thy name, that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour?
verses.pt: Ainda perguntou Manoá ao anjo do Senhor: Qual é o teu nome? - para que, quando se cumprir a tua palavra, te honremos.
verses.en_web: Manoah said to Yahweh’s angel, “What is your name, that when your words happen, we may honor you?”
verses.en_bbe: Then Manoah said to the angel of the Lord, What is your name, so that when your words come true we may give you honour?

verses.en: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it is secret?
verses.pt: Ao que o anjo do Senhor lhe respondeu: Por que perguntas pelo meu nome, visto que é maravilhoso?
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s angel said to him, “Why do you ask about my name, since it is incomprehensible?”
verses.en_bbe: But the angel of the Lord said to him, Why are you questioning me about my name, seeing that it is a wonder?

verses.en: So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering, and offered it upon a rock unto the LORD: and the angel did wonderously; and Manoah and his wife looked on.
verses.pt: Então Manoá tomou um cabrito com a oferta de cereais, e o ofereceu sobre a pedra ao Senhor; e fez o anjo maravilhas, enquanto Manoá e sua mulher o observavam.
verses.en_web: So Manoah took the young goat with the meal offering, and offered it on the rock to Yahweh. Then the angel did an amazing thing as Manoah and his wife watched.
verses.en_bbe: So Manoah took the young goat with its meal offering, offering it on the rock to the Lord, who did strange things.

verses.en: For it came to pass, when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, that the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on it, and fell on their faces to the ground.
verses.pt: Ao subir a chama do altar para o céu, subiu com ela o anjo do Senhor; o que vendo Manoá e sua mulher, caíram com o rosto em terra.
verses.en_web: For when the flame went up toward the sky from off the altar, Yahweh’s angel ascended in the flame of the altar. Manoah and his wife watched; and they fell on their faces to the ground.
verses.en_bbe: And when the flame went up to heaven from the altar, the angel of the Lord went up in the flame of the altar, while Manoah and his wife were looking on; and they went down on their faces to the earth.

verses.en: But the angel of the LORD did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of the LORD.
verses.pt: E não mais apareceu o anjo do Senhor a Manoá, nem à sua mulher; então compreendeu Manoá que era o anjo do Senhor.
verses.en_web: But Yahweh’s angel didn’t appear to Manoah or to his wife any more. Then Manoah knew that he was Yahweh’s angel.
verses.en_bbe: But the angel of the Lord was seen no more by Manoah and his wife. Then it was clear to Manoah that he was the angel of the Lord.

verses.en: And Manoah said unto his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.
verses.pt: Disse Manoá a sua mulher: Certamente morreremos, porquanto temos visto a Deus.
verses.en_web: Manoah said to his wife, “We shall surely die, because we have seen God.”
verses.en_bbe: And Manoah said to his wife, Death will certainly be our fate, for it is a god whom we have seen.

verses.en: But his wife said unto him, If the LORD were pleased to kill us, he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands, neither would he have shewed us all these things, nor would as at this time have told us such things as these.
verses.pt: Sua mulher, porém, lhe respondeu: Se o Senhor nos quisera matar, não teria recebido da nossa mão o holocausto e a oferta de cereais, nem nos teria mostrado todas estas coisas, nem agora nos teria dito semelhantes coisas.
verses.en_web: But his wife said to him, “If Yahweh were pleased to kill us, he wouldn’t have received a burnt offering and a meal offering at our hand, and he wouldn’t have shown us all these things, nor would he have told us such things as these at this time.”
verses.en_bbe: But his wife said to him, If the Lord was purposing our death, he would not have taken our burned offering and our meal offering, or have given us such orders about the child.

verses.en: And the woman bare a son, and called his name Samson: and the child grew, and the LORD blessed him.
verses.pt: Depois teve esta mulher um filho, a quem pôs o nome de Sansão; e o menino cresceu, e o Senhor o abençoou.
verses.en_web: The woman bore a son, and named him Samson. The child grew, and Yahweh blessed him.
verses.en_bbe: So the woman gave birth to a son, and gave him the name Samson; and he became a man and the blessing of the Lord was on him.

verses.en: And the Spirit of the LORD began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.
verses.pt: E o Espírito do Senhor começou a incitá-lo em Maané-Dã, entre Zorá e Estaol.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
verses.en_bbe: And the spirit of the Lord first came on him in Mahaneh-dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
